verdict.rationale: Unit's own docs say its payment capabilities include "wires" and "international payments," so cross-border money movement is a documented first-party capability, but only as a single thin marketing line. Missing for 10: SWIFT or international wire specifics, FX conversion with transparent rates, a documented currency/corridor coverage map, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, money can cross borders — international wires or SWIFT, FX with transparent rates, and the coverage map of currencies and corridors documented

citations.quote: Send and receive money using payment capabilities including ACH, wires, real-time payments, checks, and international payments
